scope: Proposition 5.1 of the manuscript “Continuous Phase Foliations Create Analytic Caustic Collars” (preprints/Continuous-Phase-Foliations-Create-Analytic-Caustic-Collars-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 147 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 357beeb0c0854e26), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 23. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There exist λ0 > 0 and a jointly real-analytic family Γλ : T −→ R2 , 0 ≤ λ ≤ λ0, with the following properties. The zero leaf parametrizes ∂Ω; each positive leaf is a smooth, simple, regular, strictly convex caustic contained in Ω; and the map (θ, b) 7−→ Γbλ0 (θ), (θ, b) ∈ T × [0, 1), is a homeomorphism onto a relatively open neighborhood of ∂Ω in Ω. Joint real analyticity here means extension to a neighborhood of the closed parameter cylinder.
